module.purpose: Provides the tRPC viewer endpoint for listing distinct members of a specified team, optionally filtered by user identity fields and paginated with a cursor.
module.summary: This handler validates team-member listing input, builds an optional case-insensitive search over username, name, and email, verifies the target team, queries memberships through Prisma, and returns role-ordered results with cursor pagination. Each returned user is enriched with profile data and receives a derived Booker URL. Missing teams produce a NOT_FOUND tRPC error.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administration and member selection workflows in the Cal.com application. Failure prevents clients from searching or paginating team members and resolving their Booker URLs.
functions: listOtherTeamMembers (~L29-119): Queries, enriches, paginates, and formats team memberships

io: Reads the team record from the Prisma database.
Reads distinct team memberships and selected user fields from the Prisma database.

contractsProvided.name: ZListOtherTeamMembersSchema
contractsProvided.shape: z.object({ teamId: z.number(), query: z.string().optional(), limit: z.number(), offset: z.number().optional(), cursor: z.number().nullish() })

contractsConsumed.name: prisma.team.findUnique
contractsConsumed.shape: prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: input.teamId }, select: { parentId: true } })

contractsConsumed.name: prisma.membership.findMany
contractsConsumed.shape: prisma.membership.findMany({ where: whereConditional, select: { id: true, role: true, accepted: true, disableImpersonation: true, user: { select: { id: true, username: true, name: true, email: true, avatarUrl: true } } }, distinct: ["userId"], orderBy: { role: "desc" }, cursor: cursor ? { id: cursor } : undefined, take: limit + 1 })

contractsConsumed.name: TRPCError
contractsConsumed.shape: new TRPCError({ code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "Team not found" })

detail.name: listOtherTeamMembers
preconditions: The input contains a teamId and a limit.
The cursor, when provided, identifies a membership record usable as a Prisma cursor.
postconditions: The requested team is verified to exist before memberships are queried.
Returned memberships are restricted to the requested team and distinct by userId.
Memberships are ordered by role descending and limited to at most the requested limit.
Each returned membership has its user enriched through UserRepository.enrichUserWithItsProfile.
When more than limit records are found, one extra record is removed and its id is returned as the next cursor.
invariants: The team membership query selects membership id, role, accepted, disableImpersonation, and the selected user fields.
A supplied query is matched against username, name, or email using case-insensitive containment.
The membership query requests limit + 1 records to determine pagination.
edgeCases: If the team does not exist, the function throws a TRPCError with code NOT_FOUND and message Team not found.
If query is absent or falsy, no user search condition is added.
If the query matches no memberships, the result contains no rows and no next cursor.
If more than limit memberships are returned, the extra membership is removed from the rows and its id is used as nextCursor.
If the cursor is absent, no Prisma cursor is supplied; if present, the membership id is used as the cursor.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: A nonexistent team causes a NOT_FOUND TRPCError; other database or profile-enrichment errors propagate from their dependencies.
